items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I used to know him... They lived right around the corner.

ctx.x: Well, we've had no reason or occasion to bring up all those names, and so you do forget. Yeah, certainly. But when we hear him again, remember, well, I used to know him. Sure, sure.
Yes. And, Burbeth. Their father. Burbeth. Yeah. They lived right around the corner. Mm-hmm. Mamie, the sister, she went away with us. Yeah.
